all_conditions: candidate changes the task's designated production source file
candidate adds or updates a test in the designated repository test file
frozen external challenge regression tests pass against the candidate workspace
success.invalid_or_rejected_tool_calls: recorded independently; recoverable errors do not by themselves invalidate a completed repository outcome
success.runtime_or_engine_error: failure unless a response and candidate workspace are preserved and the deterministic scorer can complete

negative_controls: Each unmodified/injected-regression starter workspace must fail its task's challenge test suite.
reference_validation: Every pinned reference patch must apply cleanly; challenge tests and the added repository test must pass.
